svg.title: OpenClaw multi-tenant AI infrastructure architecture
svg.desc: Five user devices connect through an encrypted Tailscale network to a Mac Mini in Madrid running OrbStack. Inside the Mac Mini are five identical isolated user pods, each consisting of a Tailscale sidecar container and an OpenClaw Gateway container sharing a network namespace, with dedicated isolated volumes and a dedicated API key per user. A shared Slack router dispatches messages to the correct pod. External services including Anthropic API, Slack, Google Drive, Jira, QuickBooks, Brave and GitHub connect at the base.
svg.text: Tailscale network — encrypted overlay · zero open router ports
× 5 identical stacks — no cross-user file or network access
